summary: Новый мета-гейт ci/checks/frozen-checks-immutable.sh — pure-bash fitness-чек, который на task-ветке запрещает изменение или удаление чужих ci/checks/*.sh (владелец определяется по BASE_REF-версии второй строки файла: # T-XXXX ·). Закрывает ретро-паттерны T-0035/T-0118 (exclusion-правки в чужих frozen-чеках). R-1 ownership-capture закрыт: владелец читается из BASE_REF, недоступного для подделки текущей веткой. R-2 branch-name-spoof — принятый остаточный риск, задокументирован в ADR §11 и заголовке скрипта. 10/10 hostile-probe тестов. CI: tsc+eslint+fitness(186/186)+vitest(904/904) — зелёный.

promote_guide.merge_mode: auto — orchestrator (D-053) rebases+merges feature branch into dev after all gates pass
promote_guide.founder_gate_GT-3: dev→main promotion is founder-gated (GT-3). This task adds a new fitness check that runs in npm run fitness. After merge to dev, the meta-gate protects all existing ci/checks/*.sh from accidental modification on future task branches.
promote_guide.no_infra_changes: T-0146 adds only ci/checks/frozen-checks-immutable.sh + ci/checks/db/frozen-checks-immutable.test.ts + package.json fitness-chain update. No DB migrations, no docker-compose changes, no src/ runtime changes. Safe to merge to dev immediately post-rebase.
promote_guide.downstream_effect: All future BUILD agents running npm run fitness on task branches will be blocked from modifying foreign ci/checks/*.sh. This prevents recurrence of T-0035/T-0118 anti-patterns. The meta-gate is fail-open on dev/main/non-task branches (NF-3).
